readme:
# local.ch Scraper - Swiss Business Directory

Scrape business listings from [local.ch](https://www.local.ch), the Swiss business directory (Swisscom Directories). Search by keyword and city and get phone numbers, emails, websites, addresses, categories, ratings and opening hours.

## What data can you extract?

For each business, the scraper extracts:

- **Business name**, subtitles and all categories
- **Phone, mobile and fax numbers** (international format)
- **Email address** and **website URL**
- **Social media profile links**
- **Full address** with street, postal code, city and canton
- **GPS coordinates** (latitude/longitude)
- **Opening hours** and **description** (detail mode)
- **Rating and number of ratings**
- **Logo image URL**
- **Detail mode extras**: description headline, online booking link, spoken languages, location features, payment methods, all attribute groups, rating distribution per star and the `*` no-advertising marker

Phone, email, website and social links are available from the search results alone, so they are included even when detail pages are switched off.

## Use with AI Agents (MCP)

Connect this actor to any MCP-compatible AI client: Claude Desktop, Claude.ai, Cursor, VS Code, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or custom agents.

**Claude Desktop / Cursor config:**

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "local-ch": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": [
        "-y",
        "mcp-remote",
        "https://mcp.apify.com?tools=santamaria-automations/local-ch-scraper",
        "--header",
        "Authorization: Bearer <APIFY_TOKEN>"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

Example prompt: "Use `local-ch-scraper` to find dentists in Zürich and return a table with name, phone, email and website."

Clients that support dynamic tool discovery (Claude.ai, VS Code) will receive the full input schema automatically via `add-actor`.

## How to use

```json
{
  "searchTerms": ["Zahnarzt", "Bäckerei"],
  "location": "Zürich",
  "maxResults": 40,
  "includeDetails": true,
  "language": "de"
}
```

An empty input `{}` also works and runs the defaults (Zahnarzt in Zürich, 20 results).

## Input parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|-----------|------|---------|-------------|
| `searchTerms` | array | `["Zahnarzt"]` | Business types or names. Each term is searched separately |
| `location` | string | `Zürich` | Swiss city, region or postal code |
| `maxResults` | integer | `20` | Maximum unique businesses per search term (1-10,000, site limit 180 per search) |
| `includeDetails` | boolean | `true` | Fetch detail pages for opening hours, description and subtitles |
| `language` | string | `de` | Site language: `de`, `fr`, `it` or `en` |
| `proxyConfiguration` | object | residential, Switzerland | Apify proxy settings. Honoured as given (proxy groups, country or your own proxy URLs) |

A business that matches several search terms is returned once.

**Proxy:** this actor needs a residential Swiss proxy, which is the default and needs a paid Apify plan. local.ch blocks datacenter proxies. On a free Apify plan the actor tries the datacenter proxy once with a Chrome browser fingerprint; if local.ch blocks it, the run stops with a clear message and nothing is charged. You can also pass your own residential proxy in `proxyConfiguration`.

**Limit:** local.ch serves at most 9 result pages (180 businesses) per search, so one search term and location returns up to 180 businesses even when `maxResults` is higher. Split large jobs into several search terms or more specific locations.

Fields that local.ch does not publish for an entry are `null` (or an empty list).

### Output fields

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `id` | string | local.ch entry id |
| `name` | string | Business name |
| `description` | string / null | Business description (detail mode) |
| `subtitles` | array | Subtitle lines under the name (titles, specialities) |
| `category` | string / null | Main category |
| `categories` | array | All categories |
| `phone` | string / null | Main phone number (international format) |
| `phones` | array | All phone numbers |
| `mobile` | string / null | Mobile number |
| `fax` | string / null | Fax number |
| `email` | string / null | Contact email |
| `website` | string / null | Website URL |
| `social_links` | array | Social media profile URLs |
| `address` | string / null | Full address |
| `street` | string / null | Street and number |
| `postal_code` | string / null | Postal code |
| `city` | string / null | City |
| `canton` | string / null | Canton code |
| `country` | string | Country name |
| `country_code` | string | ISO country code |
| `latitude` | number / null | Latitude |
| `longitude` | number / null | Longitude |
| `opening_hours` | string / null | Weekly opening hours (detail mode) |
| `rating` | number / null | Average rating |
| `review_count` | integer / null | Number of ratings |
| `logo_url` | string / null | Logo image URL |
| `entry_type` | string | Entry type (BUSINESS or PERSON) |
| `search_query` | string | Search term that produced the row |
| `search_location` | string | Location of the search |
| `source_url` | string | local.ch detail page URL |
| `source_platform` | string | Always local.ch |
| `scraped_at` | string | Scrape timestamp (UTC) |
| `description_title` | string / null | Headline of the business description (detail mode) |
| `refuse_advertising` | boolean / null | Detail mode. true when the entry is marked with * on local.ch (the owner does not want advertising calls); null without detail data |
| `refuse_advertising_contacts` | array | Detail mode. Contact values (phone, fax, ...) that carry the * marker |
| `booking_url` | string / null | Online booking link (detail mode, if the entry has an external booking channel) |
| `booking_provider` | string / null | Booking provider of the online booking channel (detail mode) |
| `languages` | array | Spoken languages (detail mode) |
| `location_features` | array | Location features such as 'Im Zentrum' or 'Parkmöglichkeit' (detail mode) |
| `payment_methods` | array | Accepted payment methods (detail mode) |
| `attributes` | object | Detail mode. All attribute groups as {group name: [attribute names]}, e.g. treatments or practice type |
| `rating_distribution` | object / null | Detail mode. Number of ratings per star, e.g. {"5": 2, "4": 0}; null when not published |

### Detail fields

These fields are filled when `includeDetails` is on and the detail page was loaded. On search-only rows the lists are empty, `attributes` is `{}` and the other fields are `null`.

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `description_title` | string / null | Headline of the business description |
| `refuse_advertising` | boolean / null | `true` when the entry is marked with * on local.ch: the owner does not want advertising calls. `false` when no contact is marked |
| `refuse_advertising_contacts` | array | The contact values (phone, fax, ...) that carry the * marker, `[]` if none |
| `booking_url` | string / null | Online booking link, if the entry has one |
| `booking_provider` | string / null | Booking provider of that link |
| `languages` | array | Spoken languages |
| `location_features` | array | Location features, e.g. "Im Zentrum", "Parkmöglichkeit" |
| `payment_methods` | array | Accepted payment methods |
| `attributes` | object | Every attribute group as `{group name: [attribute names]}`, e.g. treatments or practice type |
| `rating_distribution` | object / null | Number of ratings per star (`"1"` to `"5"`), when published |

## Pricing

Pay per result. You are charged one result event for every row saved to the dataset, plus a one-time start event per run.

| Event | Price | When |
|-------|-------|------|
| `directory-start` | $0.005 per run | Charged once, right before the first row is saved |
| `directory-serp-result` | $0.0015 per business | Business saved from search results only |
| `directory-detail-result` | $0.0025 per business | Business saved with full detail data |

Duplicates are never saved or charged twice, and a restarted run does not charge rows it already saved.

## Performance

- **Speed**: 20 businesses per search page; detail pages add a little time per business
- **Search only**: set `includeDetails` to `false` for the fastest and cheapest run

## Tips

- Use the language of your terms: German terms work best with `de`, French terms with `fr`
- Use a narrow location or several specific search terms to reach more businesses
- Pair the `website` field with the actors below to find more contacts per company

## Data protection

This actor returns only data that is publicly visible on the source pages. Results can include personal data, such as names, phone numbers, email addresses and addresses of private persons, sole traders or contact persons. Where the source labels an entry type, it is included so you can filter the results yourself.

You are responsible for using the data lawfully, including the GDPR/DSGVO, national data-protection laws and unfair-competition rules (e.g. UWG) for marketing and outreach.
